text: {"distance_m": 1.2, "reasoning_short": "Rough estimate. A small low-contrast spot is limited by contrast, not acuity. Blackwell-type detection data under indoor lighting suggest a 5% dark disk needs roughly 3–4 arcmin to be seen. Taking about 3 arcmin (0.00087 rad), 1 mm ÷ 0.00087 ≈ 1.15 m, so about 1.2 m. Using 4–5 arcmin would put it nearer 0.8 m."}
